name: Acceptance suite-3 test 75 (ArnNotEquals twin) - ArnEquals Alice / ArnNotEquals Alice prevent correlation
note: IAM-1006 iteration-3 (F1): the modify leg pins aws:PrincipalArn (ArnEquals) to role/Alice while the assume leg excludes that same principal with ArnNotEquals. No single principal is both == Alice and != Alice, so the chain is unsatisfiable and the engine must NOT emit a compound ROLE-TAKEOVER. This mirrors the ArnEquals positive twin but with the exact-equality negation - the idiomatic exact operator for aws:PrincipalArn. Standalone modify capabilities remain; the principal ARN is preserved.
